how.title: How RivaMeet works
how.subtitle: Two ways in: find a coach, or become one.
how.c1Text: Filter by sport, city, distance, price and rating. Every profile shows the same comparable details.
how.c2Text: Pick a window that fits the coach's availability and send a request. You only pay the coach directly.
how.c3Text: Once the session is completed you can leave a rating and a review to help the next client.
how.k1Text: Describe your coaching, set your hourly price and add the sports you teach.
how.k2Text: Add time windows. Clients can only request sessions that fit inside them.
how.k3Text: Approve or decline in one tap, then mark sessions as completed when you are done.

cta.title: Turn your coaching into a booked calendar
cta.text: Publish a profile in minutes: your sports, your price, your available hours. Keep full control over every request.

trust.title: Built for both sides of the session
trust.item1Text: Ratings come from completed sessions only — no anonymous scores.
trust.item2Text: Requests must fit inside a window the coach actually opened.
trust.item3Text: The hourly price and the session total are shown before you send a request.
